nodes.name: Parse Request
nodes.notes: Extracts query and session_id from the POST body. Records start time for latency tracking.

nodes.name: Empty Query Check
nodes.notes: Routes empty queries directly to error response

nodes.name: Ethics Guardrails (Sub-Workflow)
nodes.notes: Calls Member 3's guardrail sub-workflow. Returns {passed: bool, category: string, rejection_message: string|null}. See workflow_guardrails.json.

nodes.name: Guardrail Gate
nodes.notes: If guardrails passed → continue to RAG. If rejected → return rejection message.

nodes.name: Embed Query
nodes.notes: CRITICAL: Must use the SAME embedding model as the ingestion pipeline. OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims). Switch to Ollama nomic-embed-text if using local embeddings.

nodes.name: Relevance Threshold Check
nodes.notes: Filters chunks with score >= 0.72. If no chunk passes, triggers fallback 'I don't have this information' response. Top 3 chunks are kept for prompt construction.

nodes.name: Has Relevant Results?
nodes.notes: Routes to LLM if relevant chunks found, otherwise to fallback response

nodes.name: Build RAG Prompt
nodes.notes: Constructs the system prompt + user message for the LLM. System prompt enforces context-only answering, citation, and bilingual support (Romanian/English).

nodes.name: OpenAI GPT-4o-mini
nodes.notes: Temperature 0.1 for factual, deterministic answers. Max 800 tokens to keep responses concise. Alternative: Switch to Ollama Llama 3.1 8B node for local deployment.

nodes.name: Format Response + Analytics
nodes.notes: Formats the final response with source citations. Also prepares an analytics payload for async logging (Member 4's branch).

nodes.name: Split Response / Analytics
nodes.notes: Splits the output: 'response' goes to webhook reply, 'analytics' goes to Member 4's async logging branch

nodes.name: Send Response to Student
nodes.notes: Returns JSON response to the frontend chat UI

nodes.name: Analytics Branch (→ Member 4)
nodes.notes: Passes analytics payload to Member 4's PostgreSQL logging sub-workflow. Runs async — never delays the student's response.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ answer: 'Nu am găsit informații suficiente în documentele disponibile despre acest subiect. Vă recomand să contactați secretariatul facultății sau biroul decanatului.', sources: [], confidence: 0, fallback: true }) }}

nodes.name: Fallback: No Relevant Documents
nodes.notes: Returned when no document chunks scored above the 0.72 relevance threshold. Directs students to human support.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ answer: $json.rejection_message || 'Această întrebare nu este legată de serviciile universitare. Vă rog să reformulați întrebarea.', sources: [], confidence: 0, rejected: true, reason: $json.category || 'REJECTED' }) }}

nodes.name: Guardrail Rejection Response
nodes.notes: Returned when Member 3's guardrails reject the query (off-topic, inappropriate, injection attempt)

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ answer: $json.rejection_message || 'Vă rog să introduceți o întrebare.', sources: [], confidence: 0 }) }}

nodes.name: Qdrant Local
nodes.notes: Cosine similarity search. Returns top-5 chunks with scores. Score threshold applied in next node (not here) for better control.

nodes.name: Chat Webhook
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/chat — receives {"query": "student question", "session_id": "uuid"} from the frontend

nodes.name: Output Validation (Layer 3)1
nodes.notes: Member 3's Layer 3 post-LLM check. Verifies source grounding, detects hallucination, applies confidence gating. See guardrails workflow.
